title: Seven days later
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was still immersed in the heavy farewell moments ago, a completely black crow silently perched on the windowsill, holding a yellowed letter in its beak—a mark of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path.

text.content:
That gaze from the Nine Nether Abyss felt like thorns on his back. Chen Ji subconsciously tightened his grip on the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand. The ink patterns on the fragment trembled slightly, as if responding to some indescribable summons. He closed his eyes and tried to use the Tianji Record to peer into the source of this gaze, but the moment the image appeared, it was devoured by a thick crimson mist.

"Heavenly Fate is insufficient to support this foresight." Mo Xiansheng's lingering voice echoed in his mind, carrying a hint of helplessness, "Lad, your current state... is not good."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the unease in his heart. He knew he was being watched by some terrifying existence—its gaze's terror level far exceeded any enemy he had ever faced. But now was not the time to pursue this matter.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji, you... what's wrong?"

Su Qingyao's voice came from behind, carrying a虚弱 tremble. Chen Ji turned sharply, seeing her supporting herself against the doorframe, her face pale and nearly translucent, a trace of blood still at the corner of her lips. The effects of the Seven Days Elixir were fading at a visible rate.

Those lustrous black locks of hair now had several strands of silver, shockingly stark under the moonlight.

text.content:
Chen Ji rushed forward in three quick strides, supporting her swaying body. When his fingers touched her wrist, he couldn't help but tremble—the skin's temperature was dropping, her life essence flowing away like sand in an hourglass.

The Seven Days Elixir was a secret life-prolonging sacred medicine of the Tianqing Sect, capable of forcibly extending a dying person's life by seven days. But the elixir's effect had its limits, and the evil energy suppressed within Su Qingyao had reached its limit. Once the elixir's power completely faded, the dormant evil energy would devour her like a breaching flood.

"Don't worry." Su Qingyao managed a smile, "I know my time is running out... if I don't say something now, I may never get the chance."

dialogue.content:
"Shut up."

Chen Ji's voice was low and cold, utterly different from his usual timid demeanor. He helped Su Qingyao sit on the edge of the bed and took out a crystal-clear jade bottle from his chest.

"What is this?" Su Qingyao looked at the silver liquid flowing within the jade bottle, confusion flickering in her eyes.

"Ten Thousand Year Spirit Marrow." Chen Ji said calmly, "Plundered from that genius of the Xuanwu Sect. I was planning to keep it for other uses, but now it comes in handy."

He paused, his voice softening: "Can sustain you for a few more days."

Su Qingyao took the jade bottle but didn't immediately take it. She looked up, those usually cold eyes now filled with a shimmer of tears.

"Chen Ji, I've always wanted to ask you..." her voice trembled with emotion, "Why do you help me? Of all the disciples in the Tianqing Sect, why did you choose me? I'm just a dying person—am I worth you spending something so precious?"

Her fingers tightly clutched the jade bottle, her knuckles white from force: "Or could it be... you had some purpose from the very beginning?"

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't answer her questioning. He simply sat quietly beside her. Moonlight streamed through the windows, stretching their two shadows long.

Silence spread between them like an invisible veil. Outside, night winds howled, causing the window lattice to emit faint sounds. In the distance, a few night owl cries added to the desolation.

After a long while, Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice unusually calm: "Do you believe that I never plotted against you?"

Su Qingyao was stunned. She gazed at this utterly ordinary face, an indescribable emotion surging in her heart.

dialogue.content:
"No."

Su Qingyao's answer was unexpectedly straightforward. However, she immediately softened her tone: "But this time, I choose to believe you."

She lifted her head, moonlight falling on her pale face, yet those eyes blazed brilliantly: "Chen Ji, do you know? All these days, I've been secretly investigating you. Suspecting you, scrutinizing you, even wanting to find your weaknesses..."

She laughed lightly, the laugh carrying a hint of self-mockery: "Laughably, I found nothing. Instead, I... fell deeper."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao seemed about to confess something. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Don't interrupt, let Su Qingyao finish speaking, showing respect and trust for her

dialogue.content:
Seeing he hadn't spoken, Su Qingyao grew bolder. She took a deep breath, as if making some decision: "Actually... I'm not an ordinary Inner Disciple."

Her voice was very low, barely audible to just the two of them: "I am the Seventh Princess of the Great Zhou Imperial Court."

choices.description: Since she wants to speak, get to the bottom of it, be frank and straightforward

dialogue.content:
"Since you're going to speak, don't hide anything."

Chen Ji's gaze fixed on her, those eyes deep as an abyss, as if they could see through all pretense: "Your identity... is probably not that simple, right?"

Su Qingyao felt somewhat uneasy under his gaze. After a moment, she finally sighed: "Very well... since it has come to this, there's indeed nothing left to hide."

choices.description: Deliberately show weakness, let her lower her guard and reveal more secrets

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji lowered his gaze, revealing a bitter smile: "You and I are both sensible people. There's no need to say these things. If you don't trust me, you don't have to tell me anything."

This move of retreating to advance worked as expected. Su Qingyao's expression faltered slightly, then a trace of guilt flashed in her eyes. She gently took Chen Ji's hand, her voice softening: "I'm sorry... it's not that I don't trust you, it's just..."

text.content:
The Seventh Princess of the Great Zhou Imperial Dynasty.

These words struck Chen Ji's mind like a thunderclap. Although he had long suspected Su Qingyao's identity was unusual, he never expected her to be an imperial princess.

One must understand that the Great Zhou Imperial Dynasty was the orthodox symbol of all humanity, controlling the supreme power over the mortal realm. For a princess to humble herself as an Inner Disciple of Tianqing Sect, there must be some hidden reason behind it.

Seeing his expression change, Su Qingyao forced a bitter smile: "What, scared? I've brought big trouble to Tianqing Sect..."

dialogue.content:
"Scared?"

Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying an indescribable and inexplicable meaning. He reached out, gently brushing the stray hair from Su Qingyao's forehead, the gesture so natural as if done a thousand times before.

"The Seventh Princess of the Great Zhou Imperial Dynasty..." he murmured, "I thought you would be the kind of aloof, domineering type. I never expected you'd be a disgraced princess hunted to a sect, hiding her talents."

His gaze deepened: "Who is chasing you? The Crown Prince? Or other princes?"

Su Qingyao's body stiffened abruptly, a flash of surprise in her eyes quickly fading. She clearly hadn't expected Chen Ji to guess so accurately.

"You... how did you know?"

"Three years ago, there was internal turmoil in the imperial dynasty, with princes fighting for the succession position." Chen Ji's voice was calm as water. "At that time, there were rumors that the Seventh Princess disappeared during the coup, her life and death unknown. Now it seems you didn't disappear—you escaped."

He paused, continuing: "For a princess to risk her life fleeing the capital to seek refuge in a sect... the one hunting you must be the person currently sitting on that throne."

text.content:
Su Qingyao fell silent.

Under the moonlight, her face appeared somewhat pale, her eye sockets slightly reddened. After a long while, she finally nodded, her voice hoarse: "You're right... the current Crown Prince, my brother, orchestrated a coup three years ago and imprisoned Father. It was only under the protection of several loyal ministers that I managed to escape."

Her fingers tightly clutched the bedsheet, her knuckles white: "The Crown Prince has now ascended to emperor, and he continues searching for me. As long as I'm alive, I threaten his throne. So... he sent people to hunt me in secret. If not for Tianqing Sect's protection, I would already be a corpse."

choice.prompt: After learning Su Qingyao's situation, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Pledge to protect her, regardless of the cost
choices.risk_hint: May become entangled in dynastic conflicts

dialogue.content:
"So, you've been hiding your identity all this time because you're afraid of implicating Tianqing Sect?"

Chen Ji's voice was low, yet carried an undeniable force. He suddenly grasped Su Qingyao's hand—that hand warm and powerful: "From now on, you don't have to bear all of this alone."

Su Qingyao raised her head, tears glistening in her eyes: "You... you're willing to help me? That's the imperial dynasty. Do you understand what this means?"

choices.description: Rationally view the situation, analyze the pros and cons

dialogue.content:
"Let's not mention the dynasty's affairs for now."

Chen Ji released her hand, his expression turning grave: "The most urgent matter is resolving the malevolent energy in your body. Those seven-day elixirs can't suppress it for long. Once the energy rebounds, the consequences would be unthinkable."

He stood up, pacing back and forth in the room: "The Ten-Thousand-Year Spiritual Essence can only delay, not cure. We need to find a method to completely purge this malevolent energy."

choices.description: Let's not discuss these heavy matters for now, let her recover peacefully

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji looked at her haggard face, and his heart suddenly softened. He reached out and gently pulled her into his embrace, his voice low and gentle: 'Don't say more... First recover your health, the rest can wait.'

Su Qingyao's body stiffened for a moment, then slowly relaxed. She leaned against Chen Ji's shoulder, feeling that long-lost warmth, and the tears in her eyes finally burst forth.

'You... even though you've calculated everything, why do you...' Her voice choked, unable to continue."

"Chen Ji gently patted her back, his voice low and tender: 'Because you are the first person... to see through my disguise yet chose not to expose it.'

This sentence made Su Qingyao cry even harder. She remembered the first time she suspected Chen Ji, the impulse to expose him; she remembered the struggle and hesitation in her heart each time she approached the truth.

She had always thought she was investigating him, but she didn't know when she had started instinctively protecting him. Those opportunities to expose him, she missed every single one.

'So it turns out... I lost a long time ago.' she murmured."

text.content:
"After a long while, Su Qingyao stepped out of Chen Ji's embrace. She wiped the tear stains from her eyes with her sleeve, her face regaining that cold demeanor—only this time, there was a softness she had never possessed before.

'Chen Ji, there is something I wish to ask of you.' She stared directly into his eyes, her expression solemn.

'Say it.'

'If I happen to survive this...' She paused, as if weighing her words, 'I want to fight by your side. The Demonic Path's threat is imminent, and the Tianqing Sect... will likely not be spared. Though my cultivation is weak, the identity of a princess of the dynasty still has some use.'

Her eyes flickered with firm light: 'I want to use this identity to pave the way for you.'"

choice.prompt: "Su Qingyao proposes to assist using her princess identity, how should Chen Ji respond?"

choices.description: "Accept her goodwill and form an alliance"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji looked at her, a complex emotion flickering in his gaze. He was silent for a moment, then suddenly reached out and gently grasped her hand.

'Good.'

Only this single word, yet it weighed like a thousand pounds. Su Qingyao's eyes reddened again, but she held back the tears. She knew that from this moment on, she was no longer alone.

'But there is one condition.' Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned serious, 'Before I completely purge the evil energy from your body, you shall not use any power from the dynasty. Those backup plans are your last trump card and must not be exposed lightly.'"

choices.description: "Don't want her to take risks, reject her proposal"
choices.risk_hint: "May make her feel looked down upon"

dialogue.content:
"'No.'

Chen Ji's answer was unexpectedly straightforward. He released her hand and stepped back, his expression cold: 'Your identity is a double-edged sword. Used well, it is indeed powerful; used poorly, it will bring disaster upon yourself.'

Su Qingyao's face changed slightly, about to argue back, when she heard Chen Ji continue: 'What you need to do most now is survive. Everything else, we can discuss after you recover.'

His tone brooked no argument, yet carried a hint of imperceptible tenderness: 'I said I would protect you. That promise has never changed.'"

text.content:
"Su Qingyao stared at him, an indescribable warmth surging in her heart. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but found thousands of words blocked in her throat, not a single syllable able to escape.

In the end, she simply nodded gently, carefully placing the jade bottle containing the Ten-Thousand-Year Spiritual Essence into her bosom.

'Thank you... Chen Ji.'

Her voice was very soft, as light as petals drifting in the wind. But the emotions contained within those three words were heavy enough to take one's breath away.

Outside the window, the night deepened. A bright moon hung high in the sky, scattering cold silver radiance. The distant mountains rose and fell beneath the moonlight, like a splashed-ink landscape painting."

dialogue.content:
"'First take the Ten-Thousand-Year Spiritual Essence.'

Chen Ji took the jade bottle from her hand, uncorked it, and brought the silver liquid to her lips: 'Nothing matters more than your life.'

Su Qingyao looked at his earnest expression and suddenly smiled. Though the smile was pale, it carried a sense of relief after surviving a catastrophe. She obediently opened her mouth and drank the Ten-Thousand-Year Spiritual Essence in one go.

The cold liquid slid down her throat into her abdomen, transforming into a warm current that flowed through every part of her body. The vitality that had been extremely weak was rekindled at this moment.

'Better?' Chen Ji asked.

Su Qingyao nodded, and a trace of color finally appeared on her pale face: 'Yes... much better.'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji exhaled in relief but did not lower his guard. He knew that the Ten-Thousand-Year Spiritual Essence could only temporarily suppress the evil energy, not serve as a permanent solution.

'We need to find a way to purify the evil energy as soon as possible.' He pondered, 'I have heard that in the depths of the Southern Frontier there exists a Pool of World Purification, whose waters can cleanse all evil in the world. However, it is extremely dangerous there, and ordinary people cannot approach.'

Upon hearing this, a spark of hope flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes: 'The Pool of World Purification... I've heard of that place. It is said to be a relic left by ancient great cultivators, filled with complex mechanisms and immense danger.'

She looked at Chen Ji, wanting to speak yet hesitating.

Chen Ji seemed to see through her thoughts, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly: 'What, worried I won't be able to return?'"

dialogue.content:
"Su Qingyao was caught off guard by his words, a faint blush rising to her face. She turned her head away, her voice somewhat muffled: 'I just think... that place is too dangerous. There's no need for you to risk your life for me.'

'For you?'

Chen Ji laughed lightly, reaching out to gently flick her forehead: 'Don't flatter yourself. It is said that ancient opportunities are hidden within the Pool of World Purification. My going there is not entirely for you.'

Su Qingyao covered her forehead, glaring at him, yet could not help but laugh. This was the first time she had truly smiled in these many days.

That smile was like spring wind brushing across a frozen lake, warming the entire room."

text.content:
"However, at that very moment—

A hurried footstep came from outside the door, followed by urgent knocking.

'Brother Chen! Is Brother Chen in?'

The voice carried a hint of panic and sounded like an Outer Disciple. Chen Ji frowned slightly, rose, and walked to the door, opening it a crack.

Standing outside was a young man in gray robes, precisely an Outer Disciple/Servant from the outer court. His face was full of anxiety, and in his hands he held a jet-black crow.

'Brother Chen, this crow flew over from who knows where, holding a letter in its beak, specifically addressed to you.'

Chen Ji took the crow, his gaze falling on the letter. On the envelope was an imprint he was all too familiar with—the skull emblem of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path."

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji opened the envelope, and familiar handwriting came into view:

'Chen Ji, come quickly to Luoxia Secret Realm. There is important matter to discuss, concerning the survival of the Tianqing Sect. —Ye Qing'

A few brief lines, yet they radiated urgency. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he calculated silently in his heart.

Ye Qing, that Saintess of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—why would she suddenly contact him at this time? What did she mean by 'the survival of the Tianqing Sect'?

Seeing his unusual expression, Su Qingyao rose and asked: 'What's wrong? What happened?'

Chen Ji handed her the letter, his tone indifferent: 'The Demonic Path Saintess wants to meet me. She says there is important business to discuss.'

After reading the letter, Su Qingyao's face changed slightly: 'Someone from the Demonic Path? Are you certain you want to go?'"

text.content:
"Chen Ji tucked the letter into his chest, a meaningful smile appearing at the corners of his mouth.

'Why wouldn't I go?' His voice was calm, yet carried an unquestionable confidence, 'Ye Qing, though she dwells in the Demonic Path, is not a mindless killer. Since she specially wrote to invite me, there must be a reason.'

He turned to look at Su Qingyao, his gaze gentle: 'Rest and heal your injuries. I'll be back before you know it.'

Su Qingyao wanted to speak but held back, finally letting out a soft sigh: 'Then... be careful.'

Chen Ji nodded, turned, and pushed the door open. The night wind blew against his robes, lengthening his silhouette. In the distant horizon, a waning moon hung in the night sky, scattering cold, silver light.

He did not look back, yet in his heart he silently made a vow: No matter what, he would save her.

This was his promise to her, and also a promise to himself."
